result.narrative:
Boeing shows no payment distress in the record we hold: 0 DPD, nothing owed, and a single historical event — one $650k invoice resolved 3 days late in June 2026, reported by one policyholder. The payment agent itself sets the trend to insufficient_history, so this is an absence of adverse notifications rather than a demonstrated clean record. Operationally, the news flow is negative but coherent: a 5% cut to the commercial airplane workforce (9 November), no significant 737 Max ramp-up until late 2027, a 737 Max 10 certification delay and a related software glitch, set against neutral-to-positive items including September deliveries of 57 jets and an FAA finding that the software glitch is not a flight-safety issue.

The band is entirely news-driven. The trace is 0.65 x 0.0 (payment, 0 DPD) + 0.35 x 77.9 (news) = 27.3, so with the payment leg at zero the whole score comes from one article, GN-8b3ff62ef798, rated severity 4 at base 80.0. The adjudicator agreed with caveats and I share them. I retrieved that article: its body contains no text beyond the headline, so the highest severity rating in the file rests on a headline string with no supporting content. The adjudicator also questions the severity 4 layoffs classification, since the headline attributes the cut to production ramp-up timing rather than liquidity stress. The three supporting 737 Max items (38.0, 35.96 and 35.83) trace to one root cause and are correlated, not three independent confirmations — and I confirmed those bodies are headline-only too. Watch is directionally defensible; the 27.3 is not well-founded.

The recommendation is MAINTAIN the TCI export line at $9,000,000, unchanged, with nothing owed. PD of 0.1727 sits within the 0.25 appetite threshold and maximum liability does not bind, so expected loss is unchanged at $1,119,096 before and after. Given the evidence quality, maintaining is the right call: there is no payment deterioration to act on, and the one item that would justify tightening has not been substantiated. Before relying on the band, confirm the underlying layoffs report manually, and note a staleness gap — the payment review is dated 2026-06-06 and the line was last reviewed April 2026, while the negative news runs to 2026-11-09, so the 0 DPD status carrying 65% of the weight has not been re-confirmed over the period in which this news cluster arose.

A drop to Healthy needs 7.3 points, which news decay alone will not deliver quickly at a 365-day half-life. The faster routes are a re-rating of GN-8b3ff62ef798 if manual confirmation does not support severity 4, and a refreshed payment check that converts the current insufficient_history into a genuine confirmed-clean record. Evidence of the production ramp holding to schedule would also ease the 737 Max storyline that underpins the Watch posture.
